boundary_refinements.refinement: During exact-boundary serialization, the already noted missing-subject connector ने ज़िक्र किया is isolated as context, while the supplied finite non-entry clause remains a separately qualified component in the same family. The initial complete-reading note remains unchanged.

bukhari:2567.hi: Read the complete863-character Hindi field. Its supplied route reaches Aisha addressing Urwah as nephew; she describes three crescents over two months, no cooking fire, dates and water, and the Ansari neighbours supplying milk that the Prophet shared. Preserve the actual Urwah question and Aisha household answers as a companion recollection/dialogue, not Prophet speech. Separate the prefatory transmitter route before the final Aisha frame. The deictic parenthesis ye haal tha ke is explanatory framing; the printed cooking-purpose qualification limits the otherwise unrestricted no-fire statement and should stay. Actual dates/water objects, milk suppliers and all temporal limits remain; no chronology repair.
bukhari:2567.ur: Read the complete798-character Urdu field independently. Aisha tells her nephew Urwah about three crescent sightings over two months, the lack of a cooking fire, dates/water and the neighbours milk gifts. Preserve Urwah question and her answer under their actual companion/dialogue voices. The long prefatory route is context, ending before the final Aisha reporting frame. Yeh haal tha keh is deictic explanatory wording; khana pakane ke liye materially restricts the no-fire claim and remains. The milk, two-month interval and finite habitual actions remain literal; nothing is borrowed from Hindi.

bukhari:2571.hi: Read all1128 Hindi characters. Anas recounts the visit to this house, milking the goat and mixing this well water, the named seating positions, Umar indication of Abu Bakr, gift of the cup to the Bedouin and the right-side instruction. Separate the multi-step prefatory route including Abu Tuwala name identification. Ek martaba is actual event framing. Lassi bana kar labels the already-described milk/water preparation and is an explanatory gloss. The finite left-milk causal bridge and because-he-was-on-the-right clause supply narrative circumstances, so retain their exact printed qualifications rather than deleting parentheses wholesale. End with a separate Anas companion-saying component for this-is-sunnah and its stated threefold repetition; do not label it Prophet speech. Keep the final repeated predicate and source stray ending punctuation literal/context as appropriate.
bukhari:2571.ur: Read all1012 Urdu characters independently. The source gives Anas household visit, milk plus well water, Abu Bakr left/Umar front/Bedouin right, Umar request and the Prophet right-side priority. The prefatory chain and Abu Tuwala alias are source context. Keep one-occasion framing, supplied remaining-milk causal circumstance and the finite right-side reason; the lassi label is a preparation gloss. The closing Anas assertion yehi sunnat hai and explicit threefold repetition belong to a distinct companion statement within the same event family. No canonical name or action is inferred beyond the own field.

bukhari:2572.hi: Read the entire716-character Hindi field. Its shorter route supplies Sulayman and Anas but omits Urdu-only links; do not restore them. Anas recounts the rabbit chase/capture, Abu Talha slaughter and delivery of back-or-both-thigh meat. The later parenthesis explicitly names Shuba giving the affirmative both-thighs/no-doubt qualification: retain it as a separate transmitter-attributed finite variant in the same family. Retain subsequent acceptance, the eating question/yes answer and final return to the acceptance wording; that last change materially limits the supplied testimony. The questioner and resumed respondent linkage are not fully explicit in this own damaged route, so qualify the dialogue rather than borrowing Hisham from Urdu. The parenthetic us ke piche is a redundant chase-object gloss. Keep the printed spellings, alternatives and any uncertainty; no repair.
bukhari:2572.ur: Read all749 Urdu characters. The full printed route reaches Anas through Shuba and Hisham ibn Zayd; retain names in source metadata/context without silently assigning a later first-person questioner. The rabbit scene, Abu Talha gift, back-or-thigh alternatives and acceptance are finite reports. Shuba explicitly states the certain both-thigh variant; preserve it as his own qualification in the same report family. The ensuing eating question/affirmation and later acceptance-only statement are both supplied and materially affect testimony, so retain with the pronoun/questioner linkage qualified rather than settled from external knowledge. Separate only the pure prefatory chain and redundant as-ke-piche object gloss. All source words and variant order remain literal.

bukhari:2573.hi: Read the complete623-character Hindi field. The route relays Ibn Abbas from the source-named Saab ibn Jathama, who offers the wild-ass gift; the Prophet returns it and explains only the ihram reason after seeing grief on his face. Keep both Abwa/Waddan alternatives and the explicit unnamed-transmitter location uncertainty: it materially qualifies the event location and is not Prophet speech. The bracketed grief-signs object supplies the observed reaction triggering the explanation and remains. The English wild donkey parenthesis is a dictionary gloss and stays context; the long prefatory route is context while source attribution remains metadata. No missing locality or narrator certainty is supplied.
bukhari:2573.ur: Read all535 Urdu characters independently. Ibn Abbas/Saab attribution is supplied by the prefatory route; the own body reports the gift, location Abwa or Waddan, refusal and ihram explanation. Preserve the exact double aur spelling, the location alternatives and unnamed narrator uncertainty as a qualified transmission statement in the same family, not Prophet words. Ranj ke asar fills the actual seen reaction on the gift-giver face; retain it. Separate the multistep route only, leaving names available in complete source context and metadata. There is no English gloss in this field and none is imported.

bukhari:2574.hi: Read all448 Hindi characters. Aisha reports that people waited for her turn to send gifts to the Prophet, seeking his pleasure by gifts or by that particular-day wait. The recipient-in-service parenthesis supplies actual object/recipient scope and remains. The two alternatives and printed unnamed narrator doubt materially qualify which motivation/action wording is transmitted; retain that qualification separately from Aisha account and never label it Prophet speech. The opening multistep route is context. Preserve the actual distinction between gift and day, rather than silently settling either.
bukhari:2574.ur: Read all407 Urdu characters independently. The supplied Aisha report describes gifts, her turn and the aim of the Prophet happiness. Keep the explicit recipient clause and both gift-versus-particular-day alternatives; narrator doubt qualifies that material alternative and belongs to an unnamed transmission voice, not Prophet speech. Context begins with the pure prefatory transmitter route. The own words give finite habitual action, not merely a reference or compiler instruction.

bukhari:2575.hi: Read the entire667-character Hindi field. Ibn Abbas reports aunt Umm Hufayd gifts of cheese, ghee and lizard, the Prophet eating the first two and leaving the disliked lizard. His later explicit statement that it was eaten at the Prophet table and could not have been so eaten if forbidden is an actual Companion argument, not compiler legal explanation or Prophet speech; make that a distinct component in the same food-event family. Separate the prefatory route and both sahna dictionary synonyms. The printed isi same-table link belongs to the domain of Ibn Abbas stated inference and may remain. Preserve the dislike reason and conditional inference exactly; no independent law or authenticity conclusion is supplied.
bukhari:2575.ur: Read all599 Urdu characters. The body supplies Ibn Abbas report of his aunt gifts, the Prophet eating cheese/ghee and leaving the lizard because of dislike, then Ibn Abbas own table-based conditional argument. Distinguish this actual Companion saying from the reported Prophet conduct in one family. The two sahna parentheses are lexical synonyms and context; the pure prefatory chain is context. Keep the same-table link and conditional if-forbidden wording because they delimit the speaker evidence and inference. Do not convert his source statement into a new general ruling or Prophet quotation.

bukhari:2577.hi: Read all450 Hindi characters. Anas supplies the presented-meat episode, its earlier charity status for Barirah and the Prophet distinction between charity for her and gift for us. Keep the printed when-it-reached-from-her parenthesis: it specifies the transfer condition and limits the change of recipient/status, not merely a name synonym. It remains the source printed parenthetical qualification, with no independent claim of verbatim authenticity. The multistep prefatory route is context; retain the final Anas frame and all actual reported speech. Nothing missing is added.
bukhari:2577.ur: Read the complete400-character Urdu field independently. The own Anas report gives meat presented to the Prophet, charity originally given to Barirah, and the charity-versus-gift distinction. Jab un ke yahan se pahuncha to is a material transfer/recipient condition within the printed wording and stays with the statement; it is not discarded solely because it is parenthetical. Separate the pure initial route from the coherent final reporting frame. Preserve the exact feminine/collective pronouns and original words, without supplementing a giver identity.

bukhari:2580.hi: Read all493 Hindi characters. The first supplied report is Aisha habitual observation that people waited for her turn to send gifts. A second explicit Umm Salamah frame recounts her co-wives gathering and mentioning the matter to the Prophet, who gave no answer. Preserve the two actual speaker/report units rather than merging them into one Prophet statement; the complaint meeting is distinct from the habitual gifts account. The mothers-of-believers parenthesis and attached title blessing identify the already named co-wives and stay source context. The complaint/topic parenthesis supplies the manner and object of the mentioned speech and remains meaningful narrative scope. No missing delegate, dialogue or answer is inferred. The prefatory route is context.
bukhari:2580.ur: Read all432 Urdu characters independently. Aisha reports the recurring gift timing; Umm Salamah separately says her co-wives were gathered, raised the people practice as complaint and received no answer. Keep these actual named voices as distinct report units. The ummahat-al-muminin title is an appended identity explanation and context, including its attached parenthetic blessing; complete source bytes remain. Bator shikayat logon ki is rawish ka supplies actual speech manner/topic and limits the otherwise unspecified zikr, so retain it. Do not infer a named spokeswoman or borrow missing fuller dialogue. Pure transmission preface is context.

bukhari:2588.hi: Read all871 Hindi characters. Aisha recounts worsening illness, the Prophet asking wives permission to stay in her house, their permission, dragging feet and being between Abbas and another unnamed man. Then the explicitly named Ubaydullah recounts telling Ibn Abbas, his question, Ubaydullah negative answer and Ibn Abbas identification of Ali. Preserve the first account as actually unnamed and the later identification as a separate transmitter/Companion dialogue component; do not retroactively edit Aisha words. They refer to one underlying illness report family. Only the prefatory chain needs separation; all actual condition, consent and named later testimony stays literal.
bukhari:2588.ur: Read the entire768-character Urdu field independently. The first Aisha account reports severe illness, permission from the wives, move to her house and the two supporters, naming Abbas but not the other. Ubaydullah then explicitly reports his later exchange with Ibn Abbas, whose answer names Ali ibn Abi Talib. Keep the latter as its own actual attributed identification dialogue in the same underlying report family. Aisha unnamed reference remains unchanged, and no canonical identity is imported into her original text. Preserve consent, physical description, all honorifics and the negative answer. Context is limited to the initial multistep transmission route.

bukhari:2590.hi: Read all444 Hindi characters. Asma says she has only the property Zubayr left with her and asks about giving charity; the Prophet replies to give and not hoard lest withholding follow. Mere shauhar is material relationship/property scope in her own question, not a disposable alias. The Allah-ki-taraf-se-na parenthesis supplies the stated agent and negation of the warning; retain it rather than changing the quoted consequence. Separate the prefatory transmitter route, retaining Asma final frame and exact command. No independent legal permission or missing ownership circumstance is supplied.
bukhari:2590.ur: Read the complete402-character Urdu field independently. Asma asks about charity from the only money left by Zubayr; the parenthesis explicitly says my husband and limits the relationship in question. Retain it, and retain the printed Allah-ki-taraf-se-na warning qualification, including its negation. The unusual full stop before that parenthesis remains a source punctuation defect without grammatical repair. The body is actual attributed dialogue; the pure opening chain is context. No Hindi punctuation or external ruling is imported.

bukhari:2592.hi: Read all865 Hindi characters. Maimunah reports freeing a female slave without asking, then telling the Prophet on his day at her home; his question, her yes and maternal-relatives counterfactual reward are finite dialogue. Separate the opening route and Ummul-muminin title apparatus. The appended alternate route contains a separately supplied finite clause that Maimunah freed her slave, followed by akhir tak. Retain that actual abbreviated transmission as a distinct component of the same family; exclude its pure route prefix and the bare to-the-end pointer, without borrowing the unprinted continuation. Preserve source-specific route spelling and every consent/counterfactual detail.
bukhari:2592.ur: Read all776 Urdu characters independently. The full Maimunah emancipation report, no-prior-permission circumstance, scheduled visit and actual Prophet response are present. The opening multistep route and appended Umm-al-muminin title remain context. In the final alternate route, keep only the genuinely printed Maimunah-freed-her-slave clause as an abbreviated transmitted report in the same family; the route and akhir tak pointer remain context. Do not promote a reference to a missing ending or add words from the fuller first report. Actual maternal-family and greater-reward scope remain literal.

bukhari:2594.hi: Read all367 Hindi characters. Although it begins with and plus Bakr/Amr/Bukayr/Kurayb route, the own field actually supplies the finite Maimunah emancipation event and the Prophet greater-reward counterfactual about maternal relatives. Admit that body under the source supplied attribution. Separate the prefatory chain including the parenthetic bayan kiya ke transmission formula; retain the coherent body beginning with the Prophet-wife identification and actual action. This remains its own source occurrence, not merged with2592 or filled from it.
bukhari:2594.ur: Read all320 Urdu characters independently. The appended-route opening is followed by a complete finite Maimunah-freed-her-slave report and an explicit Prophet counterfactual statement, so this is not a bare chain or pointer. Keep the own body, maternal-relatives condition and comparative reward. The initial route and bayan kiya keh formula are context. Preserve its source number and spelling independently from the similar2592 occurrence; no unseen earlier report or external identity is needed.

bukhari:2595.hi: Read the complete411-character Hindi field. Aisha asks which of her two neighbours should receive a gift; the Prophet answers the one whose door is closer. This is finite, explicitly attributed dialogue. Separate the multi-step route and its transmitter affiliation before the final Aisha frame; preserve two-neighbour choice, actual closer-door criterion and all exact body words. No neighbour identity or broader preference rule is added.
bukhari:2595.ur: Read all367 Urdu characters independently. The source supplies Aisha two-neighbour question and the Prophet nearest-door answer. All body text is actual narrative/dialogue, with no lexical parenthesis beyond honorifics. Put only the prefatory transmitter route in context and retain the coherent Aisha report frame, numerical scope and criterion. No other source supplies any detail.

bukhari:2596.hi: Read all778 Hindi characters. The route identifies Saab ibn Jussama Laysi and adds a Companion-biography sentence; separate that whole prefatory material before un ka bayan tha. The body reports the wild-ass gift, Abwa-or-Waddan location, printed meheram wording, return and Saab first-person reaction, followed by the Prophet explanation. The vaild-aes parenthesis is lexical context. Narazgi-ka-asar supplies the actual seen reaction to the returned gift and stays. Preserve both place alternatives and the source spelling instead of importing2573 wording or a canonical name. The later Saab frame is the same event, not an independent new occurrence.
bukhari:2596.ur: Read all670 Urdu characters independently. Source Saab Laysi attribution and Companion-status explanation precede the final unka-bayan frame; the multistep route/biography is context. The finite gift, two alternative places, ihram state, return, first-person face reaction and Prophet explanation remain. The parenthetic narazi-ka-asar is the observed reaction, not an external name gloss, and materially connects the returned gift to the explanation. No English gloss is present in this field. Preserve its own location alternatives and wording without merging similar source IDs.

bukhari:2597.hi: Read all1119 Hindi characters. Abu Humayd relates the source-named Ibn Atbiyya collector, his public-funds versus personal-gift claim, the Prophet parents-house challenge, oath, unlawful taking warning, animal burdens and raised-hands declaration repeated three times. Do not normalize the official name from external familiarity. The multistep opening route is context. Explicit yani-baitul-mal is an explanatory institutional gloss; maal-e-zakat repeats the already established collection-money object and is context. Najayez is material scope restricting the taking allegation and must remain. The finite aur-farmaya and closing he-said-this predicates are actual speech/repetition frames, retained with the count. Preserve the animal alternatives, oath and source eyewitness we-saw phrase; no independent fiscal ruling is invented.
bukhari:2597.ur: Read all1043 Urdu characters independently. The complete Abu Humayd report includes the Azd collector identified as Ibn Atbiyya, his claimed gift, the Prophet challenge and oath, unlawful taking and the burden descriptions, witnessed armpit/raised-hands scene and threefold address to Allah. Keep the source name exactly. Yani bait-al-mal and the redundant maal-zakat antecedent gloss are context, as is the pure prefatory route. Najayez limits the quoted taking clause and stays; the actual said/repeated speech predicates remain narrative content. All numerical, animal, causal and first-person testimony scope is preserved; nothing is repaired from Hindi or external reports.

bukhari:2599.hi: Read all883 Hindi characters. Miswar reports Makhra requesting a visit, calling him son, directing him inside, the Prophet emerging in a coat reserved for Makhra and asking whether he is pleased. Keep the direct addressee mujh se and the source first-person relationship mere walid as participant framing; these are not external biographies. Preserve Miswar action, source Makhra spelling, the reserved-gift purpose and final question. Separate only the prefatory route; the resumed Miswar frame is the same event and needs no new unrelated family.
bukhari:2599.ur: Read all788 Urdu characters independently. The own Miswar account includes his father Makhra, visit/request, fetching the Prophet, the reserved coat, Makhra looking and the Prophet pleasure question. Keep the printed addressed-to-me and my-father phrases as the source supplied participant/relationship framing, along with the direct-son address. The opening route is context, but no body or actual exchange is a mere pointer. Do not infer another robe, setting or name spelling.

bukhari:2603.ar: Read all180 Arabic characters after the Hi/Ur chain-only fields. The own route reaches Jabir and actually supplies ataytu al-nabiyya fi al-masjid fa-qadani wa-zadani: he came to the Prophet in the mosque and received settlement/payment plus an addition. This finite own-field report supports registration independently; do not borrow a camel, prayer command or other detail from2604. Separate only the prefatory Thabit/Misar/Muharib/Jabir chain from the first-person body, retaining its exact attribution in metadata/context and all Arabic words unchanged.
bukhari:2603.en: Read the complete153-character English field. It explicitly begins Jabir said and supplies his visit to the Prophet in the mosque, payment of his right and more than owed. Admit this actual own-field report with its final source quote left unclosed exactly as printed; no missing punctuation or sentence is supplied. It independently supports the parent despite the Hindi/Urdu/Roman chain-only fields. Do not turn it into a translation for those unavailable report bodies or add a camel/prayer detail.
bukhari:2603.hi: Read all237 Hindi characters. This field repeats the same Thabit bin Muhammad/Misar/Muharib/Jabir route twice and ends at ne ke, without any supplied action, saying or body. It is complete reviewed source context; the source number does not create a narration. Additional source siblings must be read before the parent disposition. No camel, debt or mosque wording is present in Hindi and none may be filled from another field.
bukhari:2603.ur: Read all209 Urdu characters independently. Both repeated segments contain only Thabit/Misar/Muharib/Jabir transmission and an unfinished keh. There is no finite report body or actual saying. Preserve the entire field as reviewed context and inspect all remaining siblings before deciding the parent. Do not supply omitted words from adjacent2604 or another language.
bukhari:2603.ur-Latn: Read all249 Roman Urdu characters. Like the separately read Hindi and Urdu originals, it repeats only the Thabit bin Muhammad/Misar/Muharib/Jabir route twice and ends at ne ke. There is no finite body. Preserve it as actually read complete context. After all five own fields have now been read, the parent can register through its actual Arabic/English report only, without filling this field or inferring equivalence by a nearby number.

bukhari:2604.hi: Read all770 Hindi characters. Jabir reports the camel sale on a journey, Madinah arrival, Prophet mosque/two-rakat command and weighing; Shuba then explicitly says I think concerning the first-person weighing wording. Preserve that material named transmission uncertainty separately from Jabir event and Prophet speech. The printed Jabir-said frame, Bilal-as-agent-by-Prophet-command, specified coin-side scale pan and purpose so-I-receive-more qualify actual speaker/agency/object/quantity; retain them rather than silently changing the meaning. The final Jabir report of keeping some and the Syrians seizing it at Harrah is a distinct later personal-history component/family. Umayyad-army is an appended identification gloss and context. Separate the pure opening chain. Do not infer missing names or treat Shuba as eyewitness to the sale.
bukhari:2604.ur: Read all688 Urdu characters independently. The own text gives Jabir camel sale, Madinah, two prayer units, payment weighing, Shuba named uncertainty and the source qualified extra-payment account. Preserve the Jabir attribution within Shuba statement, printed delegated Bilal agency, coin-pan object and purpose of extra payment; each narrows a supplied assertion. Retain all actual uncertainty, not a certainty supplied from parallel wording. The later retained-money seizure at Harrah is Jabir personal-history report, separate from the earlier Prophet event. The Umayyad-army parenthesis is explanatory group identification and context; the multistep prefatory route also stays context. Original punctuation and source spellings remain uncorrected.

bukhari:2606.hi: Read all601 Hindi characters. The own Abu Hurayrah report contains the creditor demand, Companions advancing, leave-him instruction, requested same-age camel, availability only of a better one and best-repayment statement. The harsh-demand parenthesis is a finite event causing the response and remains. The opening route is visibly shortened/damaged and repeats bayan kiya; preserve it as source context without filling Urdu links. Hindi also lacks the rights-holder-may-speak sentence printed in Urdu; never insert it or harmonize the odd repeated honorific/said framing. Its remaining finite report is independently sufficient.
bukhari:2606.ur: Read all672 Urdu characters independently. Abu Hurayrah supplies the harsh creditor demand and the Prophet protection of his chance to speak, then same-age/better camel repayment and best debtor statement. Keep the parenthetic harsh demand as actual triggering action and every age/quality limit. Separate the complete prefatory route; no Hindi defect is imported into this full Urdu version. The rights-holder speaking clause is actually present here, so retain it only here without repairing the sibling.

bukhari:2612.hi: Read all1049 Hindi characters. Ibn Umar relates Umar seeing a silken garment for sale, proposing Friday/delegation use, the Prophet objection, later gift, Umar objection citing the printed Utared garments, the not-for-wearing clarification and gift to a polytheist brother in Makkah. Keep for-sale as the finite commercial circumstance and later silken as material garment scope explaining the objection; neither is merely an optional title. Preserve the temporal later-event relation, negation, recipient relationship and unknown details of the source Utared name. Separate only the prefatory route and do not add a legal ruling beyond the actual dialogue.
bukhari:2612.ur: Read the complete924-character Urdu field independently. The Umar garment account is explicitly relayed by Ibn Umar, including sale at the mosque door, Friday/visitors proposal, hereafter statement, later silken gift, objection, not-to-wear response and the Makkah brother. The sale predicate and second silken qualification establish transaction/material scope and remain. Keep exact Utarid spelling and all relationships/negations without identifying a fuller external event. The route is context; the coherent connected event/dialogue remains one family.

bukhari:2613.hi: Read all837 Hindi characters. The Ibn Umar report has a damaged opening after the Prophet went to Fatimah house: an orphan ne zikr kiya lacks its explicit actor, while the parenthesis says he did not enter. Do not fill the missing visit/return sequence or speaker from Urdu. Retain the finite no-entry parenthesis, striped-curtain reason, therefore-returned clause, Ali later relay, printed request for an instruction, when-the-message-reached transition and command to send it to an unnamed needy house. World-decoration restricts the otherwise broader dunya object and remains as supplied scope. Preserve the known/unknown pronoun links explicitly; qualify the damaged opener rather than asserting a restored Fatimah/Ali scene.
bukhari:2613.ur: Read all892 Urdu characters independently. Unlike Hindi, this field actually supplies the Prophet not entering, Ali later returning home and Fatimah telling him; retain the full own scene. The parentheses contain actual no-entry reported speech, return cause, the world-adornment object scope and message-arrival transition, so keep them with the source dialogue instead of removing them wholesale. Ali/Fatimah relaying, the instruction request and unnamed needy-house command are finite content. The long initial route is context. Do not use this fuller wording to reconstruct the damaged Hindi introduction or identify the unnamed recipient.

bukhari:2614.hi: Read all375 Hindi characters. Ali reports the Prophet silk-garment gift, wearing it, observing anger and tearing/distributing it among his women. This is an actual Companion account of conduct, not a source-labelled Prophet spoken command. Preserve the generic women relation without expanding it to wives or particular names. Separate the prefatory Hajjaj/Shuba/Abd al-Malik/Zayd route before Ali final reporting frame. The finite causal sequence and all original words remain.
bukhari:2614.ur: Read all335 Urdu characters independently. Ali own first-person report gives silk gift, wearing, observed anger and dividing it among his women. Do not invent a quoted prohibition or narrow women to a particular kin group. Keep the exact conduct and reaction, with the pure transmission preface as context and Ali coherent final frame selected. No extra language or external canonical identity is needed.

bukhari:2615.hi: Read all545 Hindi characters. The abbreviated/damaged route reaches source Anas; preserve katra and name spellings rather than restoring Urdu links. The finite report describes a thick-silk robe gift, prohibition specifically to men, Companions wonder, and the Prophet oath/comparison with Saad ibn Muadh paradise handkerchiefs. Mardon ko is necessary audience scope. The how-fine-silk parenthesis describes the object/content of the reported wonder; tumhen-is-par-hairat-hai is actual finite addressed wording after he-said. Retain these supplied qualifications without promoting the reaction to an independently witnessed quotation. The pure prefatory route is context. No broader prohibition or independent authenticity claim is made.
bukhari:2615.ur: Read the complete548-character Urdu field independently. Anas reports the silk gift, men-specific prohibition, companions admiration and the Prophet oath about Saad ibn Muadh handkerchiefs. Keep mardon ko as actual scope, the printed fine-silk content of the reaction and the finite addressed wonder phrase. Separate only the prefatory multistep route; the oath, comparative beauty and named subject are actual reported words. The full Urdu route is not used to fix Hindi omissions.

bukhari:2616.hi: Read this separate545-character Hindi occurrence completely, despite exact wording matching the neighbouring field. Its own text supplies the same damaged short Anas route, thick-silk robe report, men-only scope, reaction and Prophet oath/comparison. Preserve the independent source ID and raw evidence; no occurrence is merged. Keep the material men restriction and source reaction/address predicates; the pure route stays context. No missing chain name or wording is supplied from2615 or Urdu.
bukhari:2616.ur: Read this separate548-character Urdu field in full. It independently prints the Anas silk-robe report, men-specific instruction, admiration and the Prophet oath about Saad handkerchiefs. The finite body is supported by this own field; matching another occurrence does not merge its identity or grant reading credit automatically. Keep the material parentheses and all exact comparison words, separating the initial transmitter route only. No external event, law or authenticity classification is inferred.

bukhari:2617.hi: Read all627 Hindi characters. Anas reports an unnamed Jewish woman bringing poisoned goat meat, the Prophet eating some, immediate poison statement, her subsequent production/confession, a proposed killing and his negative answer. Both parentheses contain finite supplied speech or action, not mere lexical explanation; retain them without inventing the woman name. The closing I-always-observed statement about the palate is Anas own continuing observation and should be distinguished from the Prophet words within the same event family. Separate the prefatory route only; preserve source observation and qualifiers without independent medical/authenticity certification.
bukhari:2617.ur: Read the complete564-character Urdu field independently. The own report supplies poisoned meat, eating, immediate statement, bringing the woman/confession, the question whether to kill her and the Prophet no. Parenthetic immediate speech and confession are actual finite content and remain; no outside identity or missing event is added. The final Anas first-person continuing palate observation is separately attributed to him, not Prophet speech. Keep the same underlying event family and exact words, with pure transmission preface as source context.

bukhari:2619.hi: Read all845 Hindi characters. This is an independently damaged Ibn Umar garment report: the route repeats bayan kiya and the later Umar question runs into an omitted speech link. Keep the finite sale/proposal/Prophet hereafter response/gift and Umar how-can-I-wear question. Do not fill the missing Prophet not-for-wearing response from Urdu. The resumed isliye-diya-ki-tum-bech-do-or-clothe clause is finite source purpose wording but its speaker link is missing; retain as an explicitly unidentified resumed fragment, not an asserted Prophet quotation. Keep the non-Muslim recipient restriction because it materially narrows that clause. The final Umar action sending it to his still-non-Muslim Makkah brother is separately supplied actual content. Preserve the dangling bridge as context and every source defect without repair.
bukhari:2619.ur: Read all933 Urdu characters independently. The full Ibn Umar narrative supplies Umar silk-garment proposal, Prophet objection, later gift, Umar question and an explicit Prophet answer not-for-wearing but to sell or clothe someone, then sending to the non-Muslim brother. Keep the negative purpose, sale alternative, non-Muslim recipient restriction and brother/Makkah relationship. The body is coherent here; it must not repair Hindi missing route or dialogue. The prefatory chain alone is context, with source names and full wording untouched.

bukhari:2620.hi: Read all528 Hindi characters. Asma reports the visit of her polytheist mother and asks whether to maintain ties; the Prophet says yes.
